      def EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.gVectorCone {R : Type u} [Ring R] (P : TwoTerm R) :
      PointedCone ℝ (RealProjectiveSpace R)

      The cone of a presilting complex is generated by the classes of its summands. Taking summands of finite sums gives the same cone. Contractible summands contribute zero.
